data.current_description:
Cria um novo bem patrimonial ou atualiza um bem existente no SISPAT.

O comportamento (criação ou atualização) será definido pela implementação
da API de acordo com os dados enviados no corpo da requisição.
data.summary_suggestion: Create or update patrimonial asset record
data.description_suggestion: Creates a new patrimonial asset (bem) or updates an existing asset in the SISPAT system. The operation behavior (create vs. update) is determined by the presence and values of the asset identifier in the request body. Accepts a bens_ITEM object containing asset identification, location, status, nature, group, accounting values, fair value, and depreciation data. Returns HTTP 201 with the created asset object and location header on successful creation, or HTTP 200 with the updated asset object on successful update. Requires API key authentication via x-api-key header. Side effects: persists asset data to SISPAT database and may trigger related system updates.
